title: Discover hospital MRF locators and schema versions
objective: The selected 25 hospitals have an auditable MRF locator/disposition.
outcome: Consume the frozen 25 hospital candidate IDs from evaluation/research-program/cohorts.json without replacement, silent deduplication, or shrinking the denominator. A health-system landing page is not counted as a verified file for every hospital it owns. Broken links, redirect gates and unexpected formats receive typed outcomes; no crawler explores arbitrary sites. Declared and detected schema versions remain distinct. An enforcement dataset cannot satisfy a rate-file entry. No full-size MRF download is initiated without its own budget decision. Sealed packages/identity and frozen cohorts.json are not edited. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Define hospital MRF identity
commits.instructions: Bind hospital/facility identity, publisher locator, reporting date, declared schema version and file format. Support multiple facilities/files and source-native change history.
commits.verification: A health-system landing page is not counted as a verified file for every hospital it owns.

commits.subject: Collect documented MRF links
commits.instructions: Follow official hospital price-transparency pages and declared machine-readable locators through the bounded collector. Capture terms, size/encoding and link evidence.
commits.verification: Broken links, redirect gates and unexpected formats receive typed outcomes; no crawler explores arbitrary sites.

commits.subject: Reconcile the hospital cohort
commits.instructions: Produce exact selected/discovered/accessible/unresolved counts and a parser queue by version/format.
commits.verification: All 25 hospitals remain in the denominator, including failures; an enforcement dataset cannot satisfy a rate-file entry.
